Based on the provided abstract, the study is a review article summarizing the strengths and limitations of conventional strategies and novel microfluidic methods for extracellular vesicle (EV) isolation, as well as discussing commercially available kits and market demand. 

None of the candidate hypotheses (which propose specific experimental platforms involving particular thermosensitive hydrogels/copolymers or specific multi-modal acoustic microfluidic/impedance spectroscopy systems) are proposed, tested, or supported by the evidence in this review.

CHOICE: NONE
